milestones.description: Uses inventory_has to check that the player has at least 9 emeralds. The player starts with 5 emeralds, so having ≥9 means at least 4 successful trades of 12 Yellow Dye → 1 Emerald were completed with the shepherd villager. We check for 9 (not 6) because that is the exact threshold needed to enable the dependent crafting task, creating a tight logical coupling. inventory_has is chosen because villager trades don't fire craft_item events, and checking gained emeralds is the most reliable indicator of completed sales.

Uses inventory_has because the crafted emerald_block ends up in the player's inventory and is not present in the starting inventory. The player must use 9 emeralds in a 3×3 grid at the crafting table (placed at ~3,0,3) to produce 1 emerald_block. This is the most direct and reliable check — if the player has an emerald_block, they must have crafted it since none existed in the scene initially.
